capabilities: list installed themes from the vault's .obsidian/themes folder
switch themes quickly without opening Settings
extras: The README's Usage section is empty; it notes the limitation that only themes installed in .obsidian/themes can be selected.
intentEvidence: quick selection of an installed theme without needing to navigate out of the Settings modal
problem: Changing themes requires navigating into the Settings modal, which is slow for users who try out multiple installed themes.
summary: Plugin that previews and switches between installed Obsidian themes without opening the Settings modal.
